parameters.prompt: Stop-motion claymation style: hand-sculpted from matte modeling clay with faint thumbprints, soft rounded chunky forms, bold simple shapes and a clean readable silhouette, saturated slightly chalky colors, from the same world as a gold, crimson and cream 19th-century clay opera house. A steamy tropical island jungle: big rounded ferns and fat palm trees in deep green and teal; a sagging electric fence of thick ropes on chunky wooden posts, one post snapped; a tilted blank yellow warning sign showing only a simple three-toed footprint symbol; a trail of giant three-toed footprints pressed into brown mud; soft white puffs of mist; a small orange and brown volcano puffing one round smoke cloud on the far horizon; a warm late-afternoon sky in peach and turquoise. A painted theater backdrop flat in shallow clay relief, wide 2:1 panoramic, seen straight on. Composition: the most interesting scenery sits in the upper left, the upper right and the middle band; the top center is calm and simple; the bottom third is a plain, simple, uncluttered floor or ground with no objects. Soft even frontal light with no strong light direction and no hard cast shadows; warm colors a little softer than the actors who will stand in front of it. No characters, no people, no robots, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers, no signs, no logos.
